a lightweight visual representation can help users to understand the structure of their publication data and to identify missing publications.

a lightweight visual representation of publication information for presentation purposes.
lightweight visualization of publication data in the context of presenting research outcomes.
the visual presentation of publication data, which is not only relevant for the scientific community, but also for the general public.

our design study shows that a visual representation of publication lists is feasible.
